# Sheet

A panel that slides in from an edge.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill odv-pill-out">Left out of Brand expressive</span> Phones first: drawer is the bottom panel for phones and already holds the menu, and dialog holds the waitlist form. <span class="odv-instead">Use instead: <a href="./drawer">Drawer</a>, <a href="./dialog">Dialog</a></span></p>

## When to use it

- **Use it when:** Filters, details or a secondary form while the page stays in view.
- **Not when:** A blocking decision (dialog), or a tiny confirmation.

Instead:

- [Dialog](./dialog.md): A centered blocking window.
- [Drawer](./drawer.md): The bottom panel for phones.

## How Brand expressive uses it

<div class="odv-grid two"><div class="odv-dd"><div class="stage"><div class="odv-eyebrow">A menu or dialog</div><div style="margin-top:6px"><b style="color:var(--color-status-success)">Use</b> elevation.overlay and a dimmed page</div><div><b style="color:var(--color-status-danger)">Not</b> No shadow</div></div><div class="cap">Strong depth for floating things.</div></div></div>

## Words

- Headlines are short and bold. Three to six words.
- Verbs that move: Join, Try, Go.
- Playful in headlines, plain in errors.
- Use: Join, Drop, Go, Love. Avoid: Synergy, Leverage, Kindly.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Go
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Explore the drop

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add sheet
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.
